mercySkip.granted: A kind traveller offers you a **Mercy Skip**! Skip a difficult game from that game's menu.

intro.title: Campaign Mode
paragraphs: The Campaign is a journey through every game in Solitarius, laid out as a galaxy. You start at Klondike, near the centre, and the games get harder as you travel outwards.
Win a game to unlock the games connected to it. Only games played from this map count, so tap a game here and press Play.
Each game also holds collectibles: chapters of the Tao Te Ching and quote cards. Win a game to collect the next one, and win it again for the rest.
Stuck on a hard game? Keep an eye on the sky. A passing traveller may offer you a way past it.
